criteria.text: Fresh native install with no pairing state, after successful existing Google OAuth, automatically discovers authorized environment and obtains/stores device grant in SecureStore; no pairing code/manual URL/computer step.
Account bearer never substitutes for Device auth on chat routes; deviceToken never enters AsyncStorage/logs/errors and safe gateway URL validation remains enforced.

Zero environments produces explicit provider state 'no authorized computer'; offline environment remains selectable/usable for history where available; network failure exposes retryable state, not endless spinner.
Logout or account identity change cancels stale bootstrap, removes prior device credential and host metadata, and prevents stale response from reconnecting old account.
Bootstrap is idempotent across relaunch; restore valid grant without unnecessary network work; revoked/expired grant returns to authenticated bootstrap once, without retry loop.
Preserve manual pairing compatibility only as fallback for deployments not supporting bootstrap, but Google-first UX provider state is default. No visible UI changes in this slice.
Focused tests cover fresh install, restore, zero/offline environments, retry, account switch cancellation, token storage boundary, malicious gateway URL, unsupported endpoint fallback.
Performance baseline tests/counters for bootstrap request count and restore path; adopt only observable improvements and report measured test timing/request count, no speculative claim.
Native live Google/Cloudflare acceptance remains not_tested until integrated exact artifact and manager observation.
criteria.reason: The exact hosted-broker candidate is installed with matching bundle/executable hashes and renders sign-in on iOS 18.6 and 26.5. Production is undeployed, so real Google, Cloudflare/Synology bootstrap, and authenticated account connection remain final live acceptance.
